verses.sanskrit:
नारद उवाच।
              अथाह गालवं दीनं सुपर्णः पततां वरः। निर्मितं वह्निना भूमौ वायुना शोधितं तथा। यस्माद्धिरण्मयं सर्वं हिरण्यं तेन चोच्यते ॥१॥
verses.english: Narada said Then did Suparna, the foremost among those possessed of wings, say to the grieving Greeted: "Created by Fire in the Earth and reared up by wind, wealth is called Hiranya for the earth itself named Hiranmaya.

verses.sanskrit: धत्ते धारयते चेदमेतस्मात् कारणाद्धनम्। तदेतत्त्रिषु लोकेषु धनं तिष्ठति शाश्वतम् ॥२॥
verses.english: Since it supports and maintains the (creatures of the earth Therefore is it called wealth (Dhana); and the wealth is in the three worlds from time immemorial for meeting this purpose.
verses.bhavadeepa: अथेति । हिरण्यपदप्रवृत्तिनिमित्तमाह - निर्मितमिति । भूम्यन्तर्गतमेत्र पार्थिवेषु पांसुषु वह्निना धम्यमानेषु व्यक्तीभवतोति वह्निना निर्मितं वायुना वह्निमुद्दीपयता विशोधितम् । वायुना वर्धितमित्यपि पाठः। सर्वं जगत् हिरण्मयं हिरण्यप्रधानं तेन भूमेः सारत्वात् शुद्धत्वात् सर्वजगन्मोहकत्वाच्च हिरण्यमित्युच्यत इत्यर्थः ॥१॥

verses.sanskrit: नित्यं प्रोष्ठपदाभ्यां च शुक्रे धनपतौ तथा। मनुष्येभ्यः समादत्ते शुक्रश्चित्तार्जितं धनम् ॥३॥
verses.english: On a Friday when either of the two constellations is ascendant, Agni, creating wealth by dint of his will, confers it upon mankind for multiplying the possessions of the giver of riches (Kubera).

verses.sanskrit: अजैकपाद‌हिर्बुध्न्यै रक्ष्यते धनदने च। एवं न शक्यते लब्धुमलब्धव्यं द्विजर्षभ। ऋते च धनमश्वानां नावाप्तिर्विद्यते तव ॥४॥
verses.english: That wealth is guarded by the Ajaikapada and the Ahibrudhnyas as also by the giver of wealth (Kubera): such being the case, O best among the twice-born, it is very difficult to get that wealth.
verses.bhavadeepa: नित्यमिति । प्रोष्ठपदाभ्यामिति तृतीया ‘मूलेनावाहयेद्देवीम्’ इति वत्सप्तम्यर्थे तेन तस्मिन् नक्षत्रद्वये शुक्रे शुक्रवासरे तद्योगे सति शुक्रोऽग्निः धनपतौ कुबेरस्य वृद्ध्यर्थं मनुष्येभ्यः संप्रदानेभ्यः धनं दत्ते ददाति । शुक्रश्चित्तार्जितमित्यनेन वह्निरेतस्त्वं तस्य प्रदर्श्यते । ‘शुक्रः काव्येऽनले ज्येष्ठे’ इति विश्वः । धनार्थी उक्तनक्षत्रवारयोगे वह्निं प्रार्थयेत् । तच्च धनं यागादिद्वारा वा भूमौ निखननेन वा सर्वं कुबेरं प्रत्येव गच्छतीति भावः ॥३॥

verses.sanskrit: स त्वं याचात्र राजानं कञ्चिद्राजर्षिवंशजम्। अपीड्य राजा पौरान् हि यो नौ कुर्यात्‌ कृतार्थिनौ ॥५॥
verses.english: Except by wealth there exists possibility of your getting the horses. Such being the case do you ask some king born in some family of royal Rishi who can make us successful without oppressing his subjects.
verses.bhavadeepa: अजेति । अज एकपात् पूर्वप्रोष्ठपदा देवता । अहिर्बुध्न्य उत्तरप्रोष्ठपदा देवता । धनदश्च तदध्यक्षस्तस्मादेतानि प्रार्थयता धनं लब्धुं शक्यं नान्यथेत्यर्थः ॥४॥

verses.sanskrit: अस्ति सोमान्ववाये मे जातः कश्चिन्नृपः सखा। अभिगच्छावहे तं वै तस्यास्ति विभवो भुवि ॥६॥
verses.english: There is a king born in the dynasty of the moon, who is my friend and we shall approach him for he has great wealth in this world.
verses.bhavadeepa: याच याचस्व यः राजा नौ आवाम् ॥५॥

verses.sanskrit: ययातिर्नाम राजर्षिर्नाहुषः सत्यविक्रमः। स दास्यति मया चोक्तो भवता चार्थितः स्वयम् ॥७॥
verses.english: He is the royal Rishi named Yayati, son of Nahusha, who is of truly great strength, and he will himself give (what we want, when he is asked you and (your suit is) recommended by me. no

verses.sanskrit: विभवश्चास्य सुमहानासीद्धनपतेरिव। एवं गुरुधनं विद्वन् दानेनैव विशोधय ॥८॥
verses.english: His wealth is as great as that of the lord of riches and O learned man, repay your debt by accepting this large wealth as present.

verses.sanskrit: तथा तौ कथयन्तौ च चिन्तयन्तौ च यत्क्षमम्। प्रतिष्ठाने नरपतिं ययातिं प्रत्युपस्थितौ ॥९॥
verses.english: Thus conversing and thus thinking on what could be done they came to the palace of Yayati, the lord of men.

verses.sanskrit: प्रतिगृह्य च सत्काररैर्ध्यपाद्यादिकं वरम्। पृष्टश्चागमने हेतुमुवाच विनतासुतः ॥१०॥
verses.english: Having accepted the usual warm welcome and Arghya a and water for washing the feet etc. they were asked the reason of their coming and the son of Vinata thus explained the reasons:

verses.sanskrit: अयं मे नाहुष सखा गालवस्तपसो निधिः। विश्वामित्रस्य शिष्योऽभूद्वर्षाण्ययुतशो नृप ॥११॥
verses.english: O you born in the race of Nahusha, this is my friend Galava, the ocean of austerities who became the pupil of Vishvamitra for many tens of thousands years, Oruler of men.

verses.sanskrit: सोऽयं तेनाभ्यनुज्ञात उपकारेप्सया द्विजः। तमाह भगवान् काले ददानि गुरुदक्षिणाम् ॥१२॥
verses.english: This twice born one, then being commanded to go away by Vishvamitra, with a view to give him a present said to him; O lord, the time has come when I should make some final present to my spiritual guide.

verses.sanskrit: असकृत्तेन चोक्तेन किञ्चिदागतमन्युना। अयमुक्तः प्रयच्छेति जानता विभवं लघु ॥१२॥
verses.english: This twice born one, then being commanded to go away by Vishvamitra, with a view to give him a present said to him; O lord, the time has come when I should make some final present to my spiritual guide.

verses.sanskrit: एकतः श्यामकर्णानां शुभ्राणां शुद्धजन्मनाम्। अष्टौ शतानि मे देहि हयानां चन्द्रवर्चसाम् ॥१३॥
verses.english: Give me eight hundred horses white as the rays of the moon, of good birth and black of one ear.

verses.sanskrit: गुर्वर्थो दीयतामेष यदि गालव मन्यसे। इत्येवमाह सक्रोधो विश्वामित्रस्तपोधनः ॥१५॥
verses.english: Make this present to your spiritual guide if you think fit, O Galava. Thus did the great ascetic Vishvamitra address him in anger.

verses.sanskrit: सोऽयं शोकेन महता तप्यमानो द्विजर्षभः। अशक्तः प्रतिकर्तुं तद्भवन्तं शरणं गतः ॥१६॥
verses.english: This best among the twice born, is for this reason, being consumed by heavy grief being unable to redeem his pledge and therefore he has come under your protection.

verses.sanskrit: प्रतिगृह्य नरव्याघ्र त्वत्तो भिक्षां गतव्यथः। कृत्वाऽपवर्गं गुरवे चरिष्यति महत्तपः ॥१७॥
verses.english: Having accepted from you along, O you best among men and thus being beyond the reach of sorrow after fulfilling his pledge to his spiritual guide, he will practice great asceticism.

verses.sanskrit: तपसः संविभागेन भवन्तमपि योक्ष्यते। स्वेन राजर्षितपसा पूर्णं त्वां पूरयिष्यति ॥१८॥
verses.english: With a portion of the fruit of his austerities will you also be rewarded for with his own devotion will he enrich you, O royal Rishi, who are rich in earthly treasures.

verses.sanskrit: यावन्ति रोमाणि हये भवन्तीह नरेश्वर। तावन्तो वाजिनो लोकान् प्राप्नुवन्ति महीपते ॥१९॥
verses.english: As many hairs as there are in the bodies of horses, O lord of men, so many horses will you obtain in this world, O lord of the earth.

verses.sanskrit: पात्रं प्रतिग्रहस्यायं दातुं पात्रं तथा भवान्। शङ्खे क्षीरमिवासिक्तं भवत्वेतत्तथोपमम् ॥२०॥
verses.english: He is a fit party to receive gifts and you too are a fit party to make presents, and the present that you now make to him will be like milk kept in deposit in a conch shell (available at any moment).
